Date: 2025-03-03 REMARKSClaims 1-12 are pending in this application. By this Amendment, claims 1 and 2 are amended and claims 11 and 12 are added. Support for the amendments to claim 1 can be found in at least paragraphs [0040] and [0043].The courtesies extended to Applicant's representative by the Examiner at the interview held February 19, 2025 are appreciated. The reasons presented at the interview as warranting favorable action are incorporated into the remarks below, which constitute Applicant's record of the interview.Claim 1 is amended responsive to the claim objections. It is respectfully requested that the objections be withdrawn.The indication of allowable subject matter in claims 4 and 6-10 is appreciated. By this Amendment, independent claims 11 and 12 are added and correspond to original claims 4 and 6, respectively.Claims 1-3 and 5 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. §102(a) over U.S. 2017/0209230 to Nakagami. The rejection is respectfully traversed.As agreed during the interview, Nakagami fails to disclose that a thickness of the at least one second protrusion in a circumferential direction of the insertion opening is greater than a thickness of the at least one first protrusion in the circumferential direction of the insertion opening, as recited in claim 1.Nakagami discloses the opposite of claim 1 and thus fails to disclose the above features of claim 1. As illustrated by at least Fig. 2, in the circumferential direction, the thickness of Nakagami's element 60/70 (alleged at least one second protrusion for the rejection of claim 2) is less than the thickness of the element 68 (alleged at least one first protrusion for the rejection of claim 2).The dependent claims are allowable at least based on their dependence from claim 1.It is respectfully requested that the rejection be withdrawn.In view of the foregoing, it is respectfully submitted that this application is in condition for allowance. Favorable reconsideration and prompt allowance are earnestly solicited.Should the Examiner believe that anything further would be desirable in order to place this application in even better condition for allowance, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the telephone number set forth below.Respectfully submitted, /Scott M.
